g.text: Fleet — Role → Skill map (handler/planner granular; operators by group; foundational load for all)

text.tspan: Not loaded by default — pulled in when the work calls for it

Foundational (claude-philosophy, commander-protocol, teapot-protocol, specification-discipline, transparency, executive-communication, clear-communication, safe-operations, co-working) load for every cast — not shown.

Handler/planner are granular (each individual skill); operators map to skill groups (they're handed the skills, so group granularity is enough). The bottom box is skills not loaded by default — pulled in when a specific kind of work calls for them (not unused, and not a fleet/non-fleet split).
*typescript-standards sits in code-craft for operators; the project-specific conventions skills next to it are on-demand, not default-loaded.
